title: FarmTact V13 — Tactical Field Console
summary: A tactile, responsive mission shell turns a frozen scenario and real farm entities into explicit, revision-bound planning decisions with calculated consequences and auditable recovery.

changes.title: Navigate a decision-first field deck
changes.description: One active tactical card stays readable across mobile and desktop, with swipe, buttons and keyboard equivalents, compact provenance, a real farm board, strategy tray and secondary tools under More.

changes.title: Reserve B3 through the real planner
changes.description: Grow space B3 maps to bed-07. Reserve Space creates a revision-bound proposal after the recorded crop and sanitation period, runs the local CP-SAT worker, highlights the board and displays selected-strategy values with signed deltas.

changes.title: Undo with a compensating calculation
changes.description: Undo appends an inverse proposal at the current revision and recalculates from its feasible source. Original history remains; stale inverses fail closed with an explicit reason.

changes.title: Ask in validated card context
changes.description: Conversation focus binds card, entity and frozen planning snapshot on the server. Opening Ask performs no inference; only explicit submission enters the bounded provider path, and provider failure invents no dialogue.

changes.title: Apply layered abuse protection
changes.description: Every API receives durable global and source-network admission; authenticated and mutation calls add edition-scoped session quotas; provider-triggering routes add stricter burst, hourly and shared daily limits before inference work.
